steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text: Now that we have a roof that holds, let me show you how we build the rest.

steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text: And the storefront in the east wall, the one the merchant keeps eyeing. Its timber comes from deeper in the forest than we can yet walk. Not safe. Not yet.

steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text: This is the planning table. Every building the outpost needs starts here. You bring the materials, I handle the construction.

steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text: Two we can raise now — the farmhouse and the tavern. The storefront waits. First things first.
